name: pip
summary: LLM tools may be used, but a human must own the copyright, understand the code and take full responsibility for every line. LLMs may not be listed as co-authors and unsupervised agents are banned. LLM-generated comments must be accurate and stood behind.

evidence.quote: If you used LLM tools during development, you may still submit – but you must remove any LLM co-author tags and take full ownership of every line.
Every contribution has to be backed by a human who unequivocally owns the copyright for all changes.
Absolutely no unsupervised agentic tools like OpenClaw.
LLM-generated comments must be concise and accurate, and you must be prepared to stand by them.
When using these tools, it's your responsibility to ensure that the output is correct, and useful.
